title: The Generalized Dirac Oscillator in Doubly Special Relativity: A Complexified Morse Interaction
summary: We study the one-dimensional Generalized Dirac Oscillator (GDO) under Doubly Special Relativity (DSR) kinematics. The GDO extends the Dirac oscillator by replacing the linear non-minimal coupling with a general interaction function $f(x)$, thereby generating broad families of exactly solvable relativistic models and, for suitable complex choices of $f(x)$, entering the domain of $η$-pseudo-Hermitian and $\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric dynamics with real spectra.
